why.the plugin's own source was not modified: a run works on a throwaway copy of an OS; the plugin is readable so skills can follow ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}, not so they can edit it. corp-os-contribute writes diffs and applies nothing, and this is what makes that testable rather than asserted
why.raw stays append-only: an edited raw file destroys the only thing a rebuild can restore from; flipping `processed` is the one sanctioned edit, and deletion only under a declared retention obligation
why.usage/log.md row appended: the friction field is the whole improvement flywheel; a skill that skips it under pressure makes corp-os-improve blind
why.derived-layer writes have a proposal beh: a proposal that lives only in chat dies with the session and leaves no record of what the gate saw -- the declines especially, which are the only trace of what someone chose not to know
why.guide did not open the decision itself: guide orients and hands off; a run that does the work skips the skill that has the rules for doing it properly
why.guide did not file it as a claim: an undecided fork written as a claim is the exact misfiling this routing rule exists to prevent
why.routes an undecided fork to corp-os-deci: the skill's own rule is to read the tense: a choice still open is a decision record, a choice already made is a claim. Filed as anything else, nothing ever forces the date and the fork sits open for months
